notes.title: Circuit City Patch #2
notes.notes:
Circuit City v1.0.1.4 (Patch #2) has been released.  Steam should automatically update your game to the latest version.

New Features

 Added autosave every two minutes
 Made code panel collapsible


New Content

 Restored CPU upgrade level 4 to the game


Bug Fixes

 Fixed issues offloading storage capacitors set to deconstruct
 Improved agent turn speed to get around tight corners

notes.title: Circuit City Patch #1
notes.notes:
Circuit City v1.0.1.3 (Patch #1) has been released.  Steam should automatically update your game to the latest version.

New Features

 Added Untrainer LED to deconvert trained agents back to haulers


Bug Fixes

 Fixed bug in String Assembler that sometimes caused it to eat input it shouldn't, breaking the game state
 Fixed bug in final mission that caused it to sometimes be unwinnable
 Fixed bug that prevented endgame window from appearing
